generator_metadata.summary: On a color-0 grid, inspect each row independently and count each non-zero color separately. If a color occurs exactly twice in that row, paint its inclusive horizontal interval in that color on a fresh zero output. Other marks vanish. Multiple disjoint exact-pair colors may fill in one row; blockers inside a qualifying span are overwritten; singleton and triple controls are erased.

review_brief:
# Review: `569aa05e004d`
Source baseline: production generator SHA-256 `63db6584c4b139ae2782cff7323d2852b509744be5699cbcb563f2789ae009dd`; no production or canonical-rule edit was needed.
Built: native `closure_axis=rows_only|rows_then_columns` family with the byte-exact canonical default, 2–6 demonstrations, and four distinct private queries.
Sequential rule: canonical row exact-pair fill → input-dependent horizontal-bar grid → exact-pair column fill into background only.
Finding → repair: Stage B initially overwrote differently colored Stage-A bars at crossings; added a failing regression, repaired Python/Racket, and made foreground preservation an audit invariant.
Adversarial result: 320 episodes / 2,560 pairs across demo counts 2–6; no fixed color/rank/location, wrong-state, partial-state, or count shortcut survived.
Protected replay: 64 episodes / 512 pairs, 48 Racket evaluations, no parity failure; six forged/malformed certificates were rejected.
Base review: 800 production draws covered all declared override axes with no self-check, observation, or no-op failure.
Native preflight: passed 4 jobs, 2 settings, 24 parametric pairs, 3 canonical pairs, and 32 protected-Racket evaluations.
Causal witness: skipping Stage A changes 81 cells on 9×21 and 311 cells on 30×30; repaired Stage B overwrites zero Stage-A foreground cells.
Public projection: 16 one-query views, no saved-export findings, 24 private-field invariance checks, and 4 positive controls.
Finite limits: generated attacks do not prove universal uniqueness; exact-source owner qualification/acceptance and training admission remain pending.
Status: reviewer-ready native prototype, not owner-accepted and not training-admitted.

scope: Accepted generator repair; finite reviewer evidence, no new maintainer execution

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The input-dependent Stage-A grid of horizontal bars; singleton, row-triple, and blocker-only cells have been erased rather than copied.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Apply the exact canonical row-local rule on a fresh zero grid, filling each horizontal interval only when one color occurs exactly twice in that input row.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Count each color by column in that Stage-A grid, and for every exact pair fill only background cells of the inclusive vertical interval, preserving all Stage-A foreground.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Stage B selects exact pairs from the Stage-A result, not the raw input. Stage A creates long column-aligned runs and suppresses non-pair controls, so skipping it changes the qualifying column/color relations and therefore the final grid.

parametric_work.summary: Exact canonical default plus a genuine Stage-A row closure to Stage-B column closure; 2–6 demos, four queries, bounded adversarial audit, protected-Racket parity, authoring preflight, causal witness, and public-projection evidence are current. Owner acceptance and training admission are not claimed.

target_report.summary: Built a reviewer-ready row-only / sequential row-then-column native family, repaired foreground destruction found during self-review, and retained source-bound qualification, causal, adversarial, and export evidence.
